description: This file contains PHP functions related to rendering and positioning ad layer styles, including JavaScript code generation for ad layers, and functions for capabilities and HTML output for a specific 'simple' layer style in Revive Adserver.
external_files: /* references to external image assets and possibly other scripts via _adRenderBuildImageUrlPrefix() */

methods.name: MAX_layerGetLimitations
methods.description: Returns capabilities such as 'richmedia' support and browser compatibility based on user agent info.

methods.name: MAX_layerPutJs
methods.description: Generates and outputs JavaScript code to position and control the display of a layer with a specific ID, including open/close functionality.

methods.name: MAX_layerGetHtml
methods.description: Returns HTML code for rendering a styled ad layer with optional close button, based on provided output parameters.
